title: Piece Pose In Json And Sqlite
description: Pieces in semio assets JSON and SQLite must use pose { center, plane } instead of top-level plane/center on piece objects. Update all semio/assets/semio JSON fixtures, semio/sqlite/schema.sql (and Rust sqlite I/O SCHEMA_VERSION), JS/GraphQL if needed, and close with ticket_close listing touched files.
summary: Pieces use nested pose { plane, center } in kit JSON and DTOs; SQLite stores pose_plane_* / pose_center_* (Rust schema + I/O). Follow-up: Python _parse_piece_from_sqlite now reads Rust column names, emits pose (not top-level plane/center), maps design_ref_id and hidden/locked, fixes duplicate id key. Engine test helper reads piece.pose. Regenerated semio/graphql/schema.graphql (nx build semio/graphql) so SDL matches Rust. cargo test --lib: 128 passed, 1 ignored.
